content.short: Fluxion Network is a Mantle-native DEX for swaps, liquidity incentives, governance voting, and ecosystem token growth.
content.description: Fluxion Network is a decentralized exchange built specifically for the Mantle ecosystem. It combines token swaps, liquidity provision, emissions or reward campaigns, and governance-style voting so communities and projects can coordinate around deeper market liquidity. The product is positioned less as a generic DEX clone and more as infrastructure for ecosystem collaboration, where trading activity and incentive design work together. On Mantle, Fluxion fits as a venue for swapping tokens, earning liquidity rewards, and participating in community-driven market growth for local assets and protocols.
